name: megane
description: MEGANE（眼鏡）— ターミナルの Claude Code セッションを、隣のブラウザタブで見やすく描画する（Markdown・表・Mermaid・HTML・画像）

plugins.name: megane
plugins.description: /megane skill: opens the current Claude Code session in a browser tab with Markdown, tables, Mermaid diagrams, HTML and images rendered, and makes replies browser-friendly. Screenshots pasted into the viewer reach Claude with the next prompt. Installs the prebuilt megane binary when missing.
